description.en:
Six hundred years ago, under the Wu Dynasty, martial arts thrived. And among warriors, one saying was passed down through generations: “Anyone can become a martial artist—
but only the truly gifted can become a Brewmaster.” In a world where strength is forged in spirit and power flows through elemental energy, Ye Ling, a young man with an extraordinary sensitivity to the spiritual essence of heaven and earth, sets out on an unorthodox path: Not as a fighter, but as a cultivation brewmaster—a master of brewing spirit elixirs that can change destinies. Amid rival clans, ancient secrets, and power-hungry warriors, Ye Ling’s path will challenge what it means to be strong—and prove that in a world ruled by fists, the true alchemy of power lies in what you create.

The Song Dynasty:  
Shan Yu Mu, an artist who can see and paint the future, is driven out of his village as a heretic… Haunted by visions of countless disasters, he wanders and encounters the innocent and spirited young lady, Chuei Ying Shuang! After a terrifying prophecy, these two who were strangers step on a path toward an uncertain future. Will their path be blessed or cursed? The only certain thing is that they will walk that path together…

When he was 14 years old, Lobsang Rinchen was chosen to be the Dalai Lama, and to lead the people of Tibet. But how can he give his people a good life when he’s too shy to even pursue his childhood crush, Makye Ame? A tale of Tibetan culture, Chinese history, and breathtakingly realistic landscapes, follow the journey of the Sixth Dalai Lama.

Source: [Tapas](https://tapas.io/series/thesixthdalailama)

biography.en:
Ze Zhao is a young and passionate artist who regards drawing as his life career. He spent almost one year on the creation of The Sixth Dalai Lama all on himself. Each page could take up to 7-10 hours. In order to make the images vivid and real, he read all the books he could find about the Sixth Dalai Lama, Tibetan cultures and its buildings. His hard-working created the astonishing beautiful work in The Sixth Dalai Lama, which was first published and became a hit in France.
“I hope people would be awed by it and have a moment of realization that comic could be drawn like this. There’s more than one way of creation.” - Ze

description.en:
Jiang Fu lives in a modern world of awakened spiritual energy and high-level martial arts. With only ten days left to live, he suddenly binds to the ×10 System, which grants him a single chance to multiply anything by ten.

But instead of using it normally, Jiang Fu discovers a loophole in the system. He uses the ×10 ability on the number of times he can use it, multiplying his available uses by ten and exploiting the system’s bug to eventually unlock unlimited uses.

Now, anything can be multiplied by ten—his physique, comprehension, treasures, and even his enemies’ illnesses and weaknesses.

Armed with this bug-level ability, Jiang Fu turns his desperate fate around and begins an unstoppable rise to the top!

Jiang Fu vive em um mundo moderno onde a energia espiritual despertou e as artes marciais atingiram níveis elevados. Com apenas dez dias de vida restantes, ele repentinamente se vincula ao Sistema ×10, que lhe concede uma única oportunidade de multiplicar qualquer coisa por dez.

Porém, em vez de utilizá-lo normalmente, Jiang Fu descobre uma brecha no sistema. Ele usa a habilidade ×10 sobre o próprio número de utilizações disponíveis, multiplicando-as por dez e explorando o bug do sistema até conseguir desbloquear utilizações ilimitadas.

Agora, qualquer coisa pode ser multiplicada por dez — seu físico, sua compreensão, seus tesouros e até mesmo as doenças e fraquezas de seus inimigos.

Com essa habilidade que funciona como um verdadeiro bug, Jiang Fu transforma seu destino desesperador e inicia uma ascensão imparável rumo ao topo!
